name: Yoruno Sakura
source:
The cool and isolated, "Academy's" strongest student council president.
Because she possesses extraordinary, superhuman strength, others tend to keep distance from her.
She struggles with understanding the feelings of others, so she has very few friends.

Believing that if someone weak is going to get hurt, it should be her—the strong one—who takes the blow instead, she prefers to take on missions completely alone.

She possesses an anti-reality internal organ known as the "Indigo Heart" (藍の心臓), and her life is being targeted by the Houzuki family of mages.


[u]B.E.G.[/u]
[b]Look Upon the Rubble (瓦礫を見ろ) [i]<Widow Maker>[/i][/b]

A pile bunker that stops the time of any object it touches.
Combined with Yoruno Sakura's already extraordinary physical capabilities, this is an ultimate "strongest" ability where even the slightest touch means checkmate for the opponent.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html#Character]official website[/url]]
